mentions.name: Seattle Bar Deals
mentions.description: A community-driven website for finding local deals, especially happy hours, in Seattle, Washington. Recently launched with positive response on Seattle Reddit; the long-term goal is to expand the concept to every city so newcomers and visitors can find fun things to do on a budget.
mentions.problem: Newcomers and visitors to a city struggle to find fun things to do on a budget
mentions.audience: People who are new to or just visiting Seattle looking for fun things to do on a budget
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a community-driven website for finding local deals, especially happy hours, in Seattle, Washington: https://seattlebardeals.com/. I launched last week on Seattle Reddit and got a lot of positive response. The long-term goal would be to have something like this in every city, so when people are new or are just visiting they can find fun things to do on a budget
